extra.description: Gaussian QJL residual sketch: bias and logit MSE vs FP16 ground truth
extra.construction: 1000 key vectors of D=128 formed by seeded pairing (seed 2026) of two KV-head channel blocks of micro_kv_2k.pt (fixture head_dim is 64, so the mandated D=128 requires pairing); ground truth = exact float32 inner products attention-scaled by 1/sqrt(D)
extra.query_regimes: aligned: q = k/||k|| (attention-like; naive INT2 shrinkage bias is systematic); independent: seeded unit-random q (residual mean-zero; QJL sketch variance dominates, ratio ~ (pi/2)*D/M)
extra.packing_note: mandated packing is m_bits=64 (two uint32 words); larger M rows are stored as unpacked sign references, not the production packing
extra.theory: QJL estimator variance ~ (pi/2)*||r||^2*||q||^2/M (Gaussian arcsine/half-normal law); independent-regime MSE ratio vs naive ~ (pi/2)*D/M
